name: Playwright Scraper
examples_zh: 用 playwright-stealth.js 抓取我们授权测试站点的 Cloudflare 保护页面，提取动态表格中的公司名和融资轮次。
针对需要浏览器渲染的商品页运行 playwright-simple.js，抓取商品标题、价格、库存和图片链接。
在测试环境中启用验证码处理流程，验证表单页面是否能被 Playwright 完整加载，并输出失败步骤截图。
examples_en: Use playwright-stealth.js to scrape our authorized Cloudflare-protected test site and extract company names plus funding rounds from the dynamic table.
Run playwright-simple.js against a browser-rendered product page to collect title, price, inventory, and image links.
Enable the CAPTCHA-handling flow in a test environment, verify that the form page loads fully in Playwright, and output screenshots for failed steps.
description_zh: Playwright 隐身网页抓取，支持反爬绕过与验证码处理
description_en: Playwright stealth web scraping with anti-bot bypass & CAPTCHA solving
